residual_risks: D2N reuses the exact D2K/D2M F4 lineage. Its refinements are correlated analysis of one deterministic carrier family, not independent empirical weight or player evidence.
Finite partition congruence does not identify a cause, minimal state variable, globally sufficient carrier, or gameplay mechanic. Equal partitions preserve operational covariance only.

Responder phase, completed turns, path history, and route plus formation are perfectly correlated on the declared domain. No representative may be selected until a later natural matched-twin search decorrelates them.
Exact separation removes the declared alias only by over-refining all eight known-equal 639/640 controls. It is not preferred merely because it is more detailed.
Current formation and resources do not distinguish this split, but that negative result does not make them irrelevant to other tactical targets or domains.
Policy selection and orientation remain aliased; their insufficiency does not prove that policy or scenario orientation cannot matter outside these 24 carriers.
The extra 641 relocation is a co-formation landmark rather than a sole cause or candidate rule. D2N executes no intervention and supplies no counterfactual evidence.
The five fixed policies, 16-turn horizon, and 639/640/641 starts are bounded analytical support, not strategy-complete or live Loomkeeper evidence.
Terrain, aim, trajectory, splash, hidden information, human execution/adaptation, UI, replay, networking, rewards, assets, and production state remain outside D2A.
D2N has no paired closed route and decoder. It does not establish holonomy, global geometry, global order, source-history recovery, game balance, V5 approval, or product landfall.
The next mechanics-fixed reachability package may fail to find the required natural twins. In that case the correct return is review of a V4/playtest-backed cut, not synthetic tactical states.
